👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, 1965 ke baad se America ne aisi policies banayi ki poori duniya ne American Dream ki taakat ko dekha. 1970s, 80s aur 90s mein America ne duniya ke sabse brilliant minds ko attract kiya – aur aaj unhi immigrants ki wajah se U.S. duniya ka sabse taaqatwar desh ban gaya. 

Chahe woh South Africa se Elon Musk ho, Taiwan se Jensen Huang ho ya Soviet Union se Sergey Brin – ye sab log America jaake duniya ke sabse bade entrepreneurs bane. Inhone America ko EV aur AI revolution ka badshah bana diya. Aur sirf yehi nahi, pichle 30 saalon mein Bharat se laakhon engineers bhi America gaye aur wahan ke development mein apna contribution diya. Microsoft ke CEO Satya Nadella, Alphabet ke CEO Sundar Pichai aur Perplexity AI ke CEO Aravind Srinivasan – ye sab usi kahani ke hissa hain.

Lekin kuch din pehle Donald Trump ne aisa announcement kiya hai jisne America jaane wale students aur executives ko shock kar diya hai!!! Ab se Infosys aur Wipro jaise companies ko naye H-1B applicants par $100,000 ki fee deni hogi!!! Yaani har employee ke liye unhe 85 lakh Rs ki fee deni hogi!!

Yahi nahi, pichle kuch saalon mein America mein rehne wale students ko job milna mushkil ho gaya hai, jinke paas job hai unhe H-1B visa milna mushkil hai, aur jinke paas H-1B hai unhe green card ke chakkar apni puri zindagi stress ke saath jeeni pad rahi hai.

In fact, pichle 10 saalon mein kahani itni badli hai ki log kehne lage hain – American Dream ke bajaye ab “Indian Dream” shuru hone raha hai. Toh doston, teen sawal ye hai ki:
Ye American Dream ki asali kahani hai kya?
Aaj America mein Indians ke liye jeena itna mushkil kyun hai?
